use.flag: Install the BTest framework and test data bundled with Zeek
Enable support for Maxmind's GeoIP library
Enables Zeek and ZeekControl to send mail
Install auxiliary tools (zeek-cut, zeek-client) and the zkg package manager
Enable ZeekControl, a tool for operating Zeek installations

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Oubliette package inspired from vklimovs/portage-overlay and Bug 704850 Zeek is a powerful network analysis framework that is much different from the typical IDS you may know.
